history.note: r3 re-set from the forecaster evidence programme (26 priors, dossier per axis). Not an evidence application: a deliberate re-basing, approved by August 2026-08-13.

r4 re-base of the T axis only, against METR task-completion horizons. Not an evidence application: a deliberate re-basing, approved by August 2026-08-17 ('let's apply the METR calibration finding to the Atlas priors'). Both doubling regimes put a superhuman coder in T2 (7-month rate 2029.8, 4-month rate 2028.4); neither reaches T3, which had held the mode. T1 0.070->0.11, T2 0.291->0.42, T3 0.414->0.30, T4 0.225->0.17.

r5 re-base of the whole position space, approved by August 2026-08-17 ('let us take the whole r5 and make the full changes'). Not an evidence application: 7 axes and 26 positions become 9 axes and 48 positions, and 25 conditional edges become 144. K (takeoff shape) and R (regulatory architecture) are new; C is carved down to what is settled between the principal states. Every prior is re-set from the review specification, so the evidence drift accumulated on the r4 axes since 13 August is retired with the space it was measured on.

K rebuilt as four bands and re-based, on the r5 gap programme. The three-band ladder left 12 to 24 months uncovered and seven forecaster groups put 0.238 of the mass there; an axis whose positions leave a hole returns shares that are not a probability. Priors read off a fitted distribution carrying 15% at zero and a lognormal median of 12 months with an 80% interval of 4 to 38 months: K1 0.575, K2 0.238, K3 0.156, K4 0.031.
